revision: Native Webots transfer of frozen revision2, no tuning or retraining
native_mapping: Existing calibrated native contact. Divide front/rear forceDependentSlip by contact_scale; 0.65 is a contact-softening proxy, NOT verified exact 0.65 tire stiffness. Change both Coulomb friction values for low_friction. Gate and observer always retain nominal parameters.
worker: Existing real separate CPU inference process, one in-flight, drop while busy. delay_ms is minimum simulation availability delay, actual ages depend on wall scheduling. Zero added delay is not guaranteed zero age. Both learned roles use identical worker protocol.
pairing: Each method shares noise seed, physical randomSeed=42, world, warmup, path, duration and speed for its cell. Noise seed=base+seed*10000+speed*100+scenario_index; roles share the seed. LQR launches no inference worker. Two concurrent Webots processes; no hard-real-time claim.
primary: Gated residual vs LQR, per-region mean across three speeds then paired differences across five seeds. Report all six regions, RMSE, penalized RMSE, survival, activation, age, command/rate and wall timing. Gated full is predefined secondary, not replacement primary.
criteria: Nominal preservation: <=2% mean penalized RMSE increase with no survival loss. Consistent improvement: all five paired seed means negative with no survival loss. Clear advantage: additionally >=5% mean reduction. Descriptive t(4) 95% intervals, no multiplicity-adjusted significance claim. At 100ms require zero learned authority, command==LQR each tick and exact paired physical/control trajectories; if not exact, report actual maximum differences without relabeling tolerance as exact.
failure: abs lateral error >2.5m or abs heading error >0.6rad; infrastructure/nonfinite errors abort and preserve evidence. Unexecuted tail contributes 2.5m to penalized RMSE.
smoke: Three nominal 20m/s cases (one per method), seed 880001, distinct from reserved streams; tests interface only, no gate tuning. Retain all smoke evidence.
limits: Known DLC220 only, no sine transfer; same trained policy seeds, fresh noise. Native contact is not Fiala, dynamic parameters are approximations. No safety/stability/real-time/publication guarantee. No native test-driven retuning.
